_hiring_playbook.business_reality:
JPMC India's Pega team runs the Wholesale KYC Operations (WKO) platform — automating client onboarding, due diligence, and KYC compliance across 180+ countries. This is a LIVE, mission-critical system processing ~30,000 KYC requirements annually for their Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) division. They also build low-code workflow platforms for internal banking operations.

This is NOT a greenfield project — it's a well-established system with 5+ year-old codebases. Day-to-day work involves maintaining complex case lifecycles, building new rules within existing frameworks, and integrating with downstream compliance systems. The team works in Agile sprints with a mature DevOps pipeline.
pitch_to_manager: Highlight any KYC/onboarding or compliance automation experience — this is their core Pega use-case.
Emphasise your ability to ramp up quickly and deliver in fast-growing teams. They're scaling and need people who can hit the ground running.
Lead with your CSSA certification — it's a hard requirement. If you're pursuing CLSA, mention your progress.
Prepare a short 'Pega architecture walkthrough' of a project you built end-to-end — interviewers love concrete examples.

approach_ranking.tip: Connect with Ashish Agrawal (Executive Director) on LinkedIn. Send a personalised note mentioning their specific Pega projects.

Referrals have 5-10x higher conversion than cold applies. Reach out to any team member on LinkedIn for a referral — most companies pay referral bonuses so they're motivated to help.
Search for 'JPMorgan Chase talent acquisition' or 'JPMorgan Chase recruiter technology' on LinkedIn. InMail gets noticed more than regular messages.
Set alerts for Pega roles at this company. Apply within 24 hours of posting — early applicants get 3x more callbacks.
Attend PegaWorld / PegaInnovate events. Many hiring managers attend. Build visibility by posting Pega content on LinkedIn.

Ashish Agrawal (ED, CLSA) leads the Pega practice — connecting with him or his direct reports gives you the best shot.

_hiring_playbook.business_reality:
Citi's Pega implementation is one of the most diverse in India — they run multiple distinct applications: CitiKYC (client KYC workflows), Metro (CIB Markets platform), STARS (operational app), and Swift MT/ISO20022 MX message processing. They're cloud-native on Red Hat OpenShift, actively adopting Constellation UI, and building with Kafka for event-driven architecture.

Day-to-day involves working across complex enterprise integrations. The tech stack is modern — OpenShift containers, Kafka event streaming, REST/DX APIs. Citi expects developers who can handle both Pega platform work and integration architecture.
pitch_to_manager: Highlight any KYC/onboarding or compliance automation experience — this is their core Pega use-case.
Emphasise payments processing or financial transaction workflow experience.
Showcase your case management and customer service automation expertise — it maps directly to their implementation.
Mention Constellation UI / DX API experience — they're actively adopting it and it's a rare skill.
Highlight Kafka / event-driven architecture experience — shows you can handle their integration patterns.
Emphasise your ability to ramp up quickly and deliver in fast-growing teams. They're scaling and need people who can hit the ground running.

team_members.title: Pega Lead System Architect - 6yr+ at SCB

career.detail: Returned to SCB after a gap. Total SCB tenure: 6+ years across stints.
Promoted after 4yr as Dev.
NEW hire. Dispute Resolution, Fire Insurance, Collateral, Loan Applications. Nordea + Citi Program experience.

_hiring_playbook.business_reality:
Standard Chartered uses Pega for trade finance operations, client onboarding, and compliance workflows across their Asia/Middle East/Africa markets. The team handles complex multi-jurisdiction banking processes.

SC is unique because of their emerging markets focus — the Pega work involves multi-country regulatory compliance (not just India/US). If you understand cross-border banking regulations, you're extremely valuable to them.
pitch_to_manager: Talk about CDH, Next-Best-Action, or any decisioning/marketing automation experience.
Emphasise your ability to ramp up quickly and deliver in fast-growing teams. They're scaling and need people who can hit the ground running.
Lead with your CSSA certification — it's a hard requirement. If you're pursuing CLSA, mention your progress.
Prepare a short 'Pega architecture walkthrough' of a project you built end-to-end — interviewers love concrete examples.

approach_ranking.tip: Connect with Ashutosh Hingankar (Decisioning Architect) on LinkedIn. Send a personalised note mentioning their specific Pega projects.
Apply directly at Standard Chartered's career site with Pega-keyword-optimised resume. Most GCC hiring funnels route through the portal.
Referrals have 5-10x higher conversion than cold applies. Reach out to any team member on LinkedIn for a referral — most companies pay referral bonuses so they're motivated to help.
Search for 'Standard Chartered talent acquisition' or 'Standard Chartered recruiter technology' on LinkedIn. InMail gets noticed more than regular messages.
Set alerts for Pega roles at this company. Apply within 24 hours of posting — early applicants get 3x more callbacks.
Attend PegaWorld / PegaInnovate events. Many hiring managers attend. Build visibility by posting Pega content on LinkedIn.

_hiring_playbook.insider_tip: Standard Chartered often hires Pega developers who previously worked at other banks (they value banking domain knowledge heavily). If you're currently at a consulting company working on a banking client, SC considers that relevant experience.

Major Pega estate in Netherlands — KYC/CLM, lending, mortgage workflows, Pega SaaS migration, Constellation & GenAI POCs. Annual 'Proud of Pega Day' event. Multiple Pega Chapter Leads and CLSAs. No India GCC for Pega — team is entirely in Utrecht, Netherlands.

pitch_to_manager: Highlight any KYC/onboarding or compliance automation experience — this is their core Pega use-case.
Mention Constellation UI / DX API experience — they're actively adopting it and it's a rare skill.
Discuss cloud deployment experience (Pega Cloud / containerised Pega) — they value cloud-native skills.
Talk about Pega GenAI features or any AI/ML integration work — this is cutting-edge and they're investing heavily.
Share your version upgrade/migration experience (PRPC to Infinity, Classic to Cosmos). This is exactly what they need.
Show deep technical depth and ownership mindset — stable teams value senior contributors who can take full ownership of modules.

Referrals have 5-10x higher conversion than cold applies. Reach out to any team member on LinkedIn for a referral — most companies pay referral bonuses so they're motivated to help.
Search for 'Rabobank talent acquisition' or 'Rabobank recruiter technology' on LinkedIn. InMail gets noticed more than regular messages.

methodology: All three scanner catalogs are parsed with ast.literal_eval; scanner imports, logging and network behavior are never executed.
Historical snapshots are preserved in full. Dossier values lead the merged view; original source variants retain every conflicting field and profile.
A named profile is an observed historical profile, not proof of current employment or a complete team headcount.
Matching uses explicit exact normalized aliases; ambiguous mappings remain unmatched. Global targets reuse India information only with an explicit scope label.
Search links and career URLs are navigation aids from the catalog, not claims of open vacancies. Pending checks are not zero jobs.
Category counts describe catalog targets, including overseas and broad searches; they are not unique employers or verified Pega teams.
